name: The Grove
description: The Grove is Los Angeles' premier open-air shopping and lifestyle destination, featuring a curated mix of retail, restaurants, and entertainment in a vibrant, pedestrian-friendly environment. Located in the heart of LA, this iconic shopping center combines European-inspired architecture with California energy, offering visitors an unforgettable experience complete with a historic trolley, central fountain, and movie theater. From luxury brands to dining experiences and family-friendly events, The Grove has become a beloved gathering place for locals and tourists alike.
